verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Viam's Fleet Management APIs support managing permissions and authorization across organizations, locations, and machines (viam-docs-10, viam-docs-20, viam-docs-34), but the evidence pack lacks detail on granular role definitions (e.g., command vs. configure vs. view-only roles), per-robot scoping, or how these permissions are enforced/audited in practice. missing for 10: detailed RBAC role granularity (command/configure/view distinctions), per-machine permission scoping examples, UI walkthrough of assigning roles, and independent/hands-on verification that access control works as documented.
